label: Bible Study
prompt: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and _____ us.
verse: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
note: Paul's night vision — the call that sent his team across the sea to Macedonia.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And, behold, I come _____; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verse: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
note: Near the Bible's last page, Jesus promises: I come quickly, and my reward is with me.

label: Sunday School
prompt: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the _____, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verse: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
note: Free fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, garlic — Israel waxing nostalgic about Egypt's menu and forgetting the slavery.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Mary said, Behold the _____ of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verse: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
note: Mary's answer to Gabriel: no bargaining, no delay — just a servant's yes to the impossible.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The grass _____, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
verse: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
note: The grass 'withereth,' the flower fadeth — but the very next verse says the word of our God shall stand for ever.
